pages.text: Clothcrafting Station is needed to process spools into certain fabric types. This crafting station uses minigame to check your skills, the better you perform - the better $(l:weaversparadise:getting_started/clothcrafting#quality)$(bold)quality$() fabric you will get!

pages.title: Quality
pages.text: Quality of fabric affects the durability of clothing crafted from it. Clothing has a base durability determined by the amount of fabric used, while fabric quality provides an additional durability bonus. The higher the quality, the larger the bonus.$(br)$(br)For example, a shirt requires 14 Cotton, giving it 140 base durability. The quality of the Cotton can then add up to 100 additional durability, for a maximum of 240 durability.$(br)$(br)Durability per fabric:$(br)Cotton - 10 durability (up to +100 from quality)$(br)Silk - 8 durability (up to +80 from quality)$(br)Wool - 12 durability (up to +120 from quality)$(br)Jeans - 15 durability (up to +150 from quality)
